description:
`dev/research/f3_bipedal` is outside the Cargo workspace, so no gate reaches it: its tests never run in CI, and its Clippy failure and test-naming deviation have gone unobserved.

## Background

The crate is excluded from the root workspace deliberately — it carries its own `[workspace]` table and is consumed only as a path dev-dependency by `gf2-kernels-simd`. The `cargo-ci` gate runs `cargo check`, `cargo nextest run`, and `cargo clippy` with `--workspace`, so it compiles this crate as a dependency but never runs its test suite or lints it.

The repository already has the pattern for this: `gf2-kernels-hip` and `dev/research/permanent-sampling-feas` each carry a dedicated gate that runs the standalone crate's release tests, formatting, and Clippy, described as covering exactly what workspace `cargo-ci` excludes. `f3_bipedal` has no equivalent, and two defects have accumulated behind the gap:

- Clippy fails today. `cargo clippy --manifest-path dev/research/f3_bipedal/Cargo.toml --release --all-targets -- -D warnings` reports `clippy::len_without_is_empty` against the `F3Encoding` trait in `dev/research/f3_bipedal/src/common.rs:40`, which declares `len` with no `is_empty`.
- Test functions in the crate are named without the project's required `test_<operation>_<scenario>` prefix, for example `pack_unpack_roundtrip` and `exhaustive_add_pairs`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A gate in the repository's gate registry runs this crate's release test suite, formatting check, and Clippy with warnings denied, following the shape of the existing standalone-crate gates.
- [hard] REQ-02: `cargo clippy --manifest-path dev/research/f3_bipedal/Cargo.toml --release --all-targets -- -D warnings` exits zero.
- [hard] REQ-03: Every test function in the crate is named `test_<operation>_<scenario>`, and each renamed function keeps its original assertions; no test is dropped, merged, or weakened.
- [hard] REQ-04: The crate's release test suite passes after the renames.

## Notes

REQ-02 is satisfied by giving `F3Encoding` an `is_empty` method, not by an `allow` attribute; the trait models a packed-vector encoding where emptiness is a meaningful query.
title: Bring dev/research/f3_bipedal under a CI gate and the test-naming convention
